report.title: Quantity can go negative
report.body: clicked the minus button on the coffee beans a few times and now the quantity says -2 and my total is NEGATIVE. i basically get paid to take coffee lol. should stop at 1 or remove the item i guess

app_label: Corner Shop, a small online coffee-gear store with a cart and coupon codes

preconditions: the store has a product called coffee beans that can be added to the cart
steps: Open the coffee beans product in the store
Click the add to cart button for the coffee beans
Click the minus button next to the coffee beans once
Click the minus button next to the coffee beans a second time
Click the minus button next to the coffee beans a third time
Click the minus button next to the coffee beans a fourth time
plan.expected: The coffee beans quantity never shows a negative number and the cart total is never negative; the quantity stays at 1 or the item is removed from the cart.
plan.reported_actual: After clicking the minus button on the coffee beans several times, the quantity shows -2 and the cart total is negative.
missing: How many coffee beans were in the cart before clicking minus, and how many times exactly was minus clicked?
Which exact behavior is desired at quantity 1: stay at 1 or remove the item? (reporter is unsure)
Which page was the minus button on (cart page, product page, or mini-cart)?
assumed: the minus button is in the cart view next to the coffee beans line item
assumed: the coffee beans start in the cart with quantity 1 after adding once, and four minus clicks are enough to reach a negative quantity
assumed: the item is added to the cart through the normal add to cart button since the report does not say how it got there
plan.summary: Clicking minus on coffee beans in the cart makes quantity and total go negative

# Quantity can go negative

## Reproduce the report
Open http://localhost:4100/.
Stay on localhost:4100 for the whole run and do not open any other website.
Do each step once, in order. If the app behaves unexpectedly, do not undo, retry, repair or work around it: the behavior itself is what is being checked. Check the result right after the last step.
Steps:
1. Open the coffee beans product in the store
2. Click the add to cart button for the coffee beans
3. Open the cart
4. Click the minus button next to the coffee beans once
5. Click the minus button next to the coffee beans a second time
6. Click the minus button next to the coffee beans a third time
7. Click the minus button next to the coffee beans a fourth time
The reporter says the correct behavior is that The coffee beans quantity never shows a negative number and the cart total is never negative; the quantity stays at 1 or the item is removed from the cart. Verify that The coffee beans quantity never shows a negative number and the cart total is never negative; the quantity stays at 1 or the item is removed from the cart.

verdict.headline: Repeated use of the coffee-beans minus control drove the cart below zero instead of keeping the quantity at one or removing the item.
verdict.root_cause: The cart does not stop the minus control at zero or remove the item when its quantity reaches zero, so each additional click subtracts another item and makes the total negative.
verdict.suggested_fix: Prevent decrements below zero. At zero, either keep the quantity at one as intended or remove the cart item, and ensure subtotal and total cannot become negative.

fixes.rationale: changeQty applied the delta with no lower bound, so repeated minus clicks pushed qty below zero and made the total negative. Clamping the quantity at a minimum of 1 keeps it positive.
